description: L4 symptomatic guidelines (supportive fallback contract v2). Reviewed and approved 2026-11-05. Source priority: (1) international societies, (2) US societies, (3) other national bodies only when (1)-(2) have no usable management guideline, with the reason. Every quote is checked against the local verified record (.cache/guidelines/<id>/verified.json, not committed; sha256 below).

guidelines.title: AES evidence-based guideline: treatment of convulsive status epilepticus in children and adults
guidelines.status: listed among current AES evidence-based guidelines on aesnet.org (checked 2026-11-05); an AES status epilepticus guideline revision is listed as in development

recommendations.name: benzodiazepine rescue for prolonged seizures (IV lorazepam or IV diazepam)
recommendations.quote: In children, intravenous lorazepam and intravenous diazepam are established as efficacious at stopping seizures lasting at least 5 minutes (Level A)

guidelines.title: AAN/AES practice guideline update: efficacy and tolerability of the new antiepileptic drugs I: treatment of new-onset epilepsy
guidelines.body: American Academy of Neurology and American Epilepsy Society
guidelines.rule: drug recommendations only when the case states the matching seizure type (decision 2026-11-05)

recommendations.name: ethosuximide or valproic acid before lamotrigine for absence seizures
recommendations.quote: ethosuximide (ETS) or valproic acid (VPA) should be considered before LTG to decrease seizure frequency in treating absence seizures in childhood absence epilepsy (Level B)

guidelines.title: Epilepsies in children, young people and adults (NG217)
guidelines.reason_level_3: no current international or US-society guideline on general epilepsy management (individualised treatment plan) was found (checked 2026-11-05: ILAE has neonatal, infantile-seizure and psychiatric topics only; AES 2016 covers status epilepticus and AAN/AES 2018 drug choice)

recommendations.name: individualised antiseizure medication treatment strategy
recommendations.quote: Develop an individualised antiseizure medication treatment strategy with the person, and their family and carers if appropriate

guidelines.title: Diagnosis and Management of Global Development Delay: consensus guidelines of three chapters of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics
guidelines.body: Indian Academy of Pediatrics (Growth, Development and Behavioral Pediatrics Chapter; Neurology Chapter; Neurodevelopment Pediatrics Chapter)
guidelines.version: Indian Pediatrics, FEBRUARY 19, 2022 [E-PUB AHEAD OF PRINT]
guidelines.rule: intervention-type items only; 5A (NICU only), 5B (finding the cause), 5C (routine health care) and 5E (screening) are not used - see not_used in the verified record

recommendations.name: start early intervention as soon as the delay is recognized
recommendations.quote: Early intervention should be initiated soon after the delay is recognized, instead of waiting for a formal diagnosis.

recommendations.name: multidisciplinary developmental intervention team (developmental paediatrics or paediatric neurology, clinical psychology, occupational therapy, physiotherapy, special education, speech therapy)
recommendations.quote: This requires a multi-disciplinary team consisting of developmental pediatrician/pediatric neurologists, clinical psychologists, occupational therapists, physiotherapists, special educators and speech therapists.

recommendations.name: preschool education services in the least restrictive environment
recommendations.quote: Children with GDD should receive preschool education services in the least restrictive environment that is possible and appropriate to address their needs.

developmental_delay_intellectual_disabil.level_3_reason: levels (1)-(2) have no usable intervention guideline: no international society guideline on the management of developmental delay was found, and the only US candidate, AAP 2013 (Early Intervention, IDEA Part C Services, and the Medical Home, PMID 24082001), is a clinical report whose abstract carries no recommendation sentence and whose reaffirmation status could not be verified (the 16 'AAP Publications Reaffirmed/Retired' notices in PubMed have no abstracts). Decision 2026-11-05: use IAP 2022 instead, with this reason recorded.

guidelines.title: ESPGHAN guidelines for the evaluation and treatment of gastrointestinal and nutritional complications in children with neurological impairment
guidelines.version: J Pediatr Gastroenterol Nutr 2017;65(2):242-264; DOI 10.1097/MPG.0000000000001646 (author accepted manuscript)

recommendations.name: multidisciplinary nutritional evaluation and management
recommendations.quote: ESPGHAN WG suggests that nutritional evaluation and management should be performed by a multidisciplinary team

recommendations.name: speech and language therapy for oropharyngeal dysfunction
recommendations.quote: ESPGHAN WG suggests considering speech and language interventions in the treatment of NI children with oropharyngeal dysfunction

recommendations.name: enteral tube feeding
recommendations.quote: ESPGHAN WG recommends using enteral tube feeding in cases of unsafe or inefficient oral feeding, preferably before the development of undernutrition
